name: room-host
description: A service that stores data-room records. Provisioned as an ordinary integration so that a person can host their own rooms on infrastructure they control (topology T1 of the data-rooms design) without that surface living inside the VTA — the process guarding the master seed must not also terminate presentations from arbitrary DIDs. A room-host holds ciphertext and verifies presentations; it holds no member list and no room keys, so its ACL entry should be scoped to exactly the oracle verbs it needs and nothing wider. Advertises REST for the rooms/* task surface and DIDComm so a room's own DID can route through the same mediator.
